<!--
The user-facing release note: one short paragraph saying what changed and why
someone using the app would care. This is what the release ships, so no file
names, no commit hashes, no "refactored" -- write it for someone who never
sees the code.

One block per change a user can see: a change that is three things to a user
is three blocks, not one long one.

If the change is not visible to users, say so instead, in a line of its own:
No-User-Note: <why>. The release-notes check reads that line and lets the
change through.
-->
<!-- /notes -->
